title: Metals slump; Tata Steel down over 6%

timeline.title: Metals slump; Tata Steel down over 6%
timeline.line: Nifty Metal fell about 4% intraday on West Asia tensions and a firmer dollar
more: SAIL, NMDC and Hindustan Copper also fell sharply
Investors are cutting exposure to cyclicals
The index touched about 11,773 vs a 12,269.8 previous close
